needs_atom.missing: When that mana is spent to cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.: two missing pieces. (1) No event for 'the mana THIS ability produced is spent to cast a spell matching a filter' (mana provenance tracking; CastSpellEvent cannot say which mana paid the cost). (2) Copying a spell on the stack with 'you may choose new targets': Verb.COPY exists in the IR but is not in SUPPORTED_VERBS_V2 (no executor handler), and the M21 Double Vision template is the only copy precedent. The '{T}: Add {R}.' mana ability compiles correctly.
